instructions: Classify the current voice request. Quoted commands and ordinary sentences are dictation. Follow the latest correction. Unclear unfinished requests are unknown.

options.dictation: text to type; no request for an action
options.close_application: quit or close a Mac app
options.search: look up information or search a site
options.media_action: play, pause, skip or change music
options.system_action: change computer settings or lock it

instructions: Classify the risk of carrying out the voice request. Closing apps may lose work. Locking or sleeping interrupts work. Typing ordinary text and searching are safe.

options.reversible: opening apps, music, notes, reminders, volume
options.consequential: closing apps, deleting, sending, locking or sleeping

instructions: Does the request need more speech to resolve ambiguity, unfinished phrasing, missing targets or a correction? Completed clear requests do not.
